verdict.rationale: Ardent has no native background-automation or scheduling feature. It does support automation-style workflows: every PR gets its own database branch in CI, connectors can run SQL automatically on every new branch, and the API, ARDENT_TOKEN and JSON outputs suit unattended CI harnesses and agents that create and delete their own branches. These automations are driven by external CI or agent tooling rather than set up and run by Ardent itself. Missing for 10: a first-party scheduler or trigger system for autonomous background jobs, documentation of automations running independently of external CI, and independent hands-on corroboration.
